headline: Ingersoll Rand Expands Key Blower Technologies, Rental Capabilities, and Services with Acquisition of Lone Star Blower, Inc.
summary: DAVIDSON, N.C., August 03, 2026--Ingersoll Rand Inc., (NYSE: IR) a global provider of mission-critical flow creation and life science and industrial solutions, has acquired Lone Star Blower, Inc. dba Lone Star Turbo ("Lone Star"), expanding the company’s Industrial Technologies and Services portfolio.
